test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

That ship has sailed
solution:
The correct answer is **Too late to do something.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Idiom** refers to a **phrase or group of words signifying a meaning different from its normal syntactical meaning**.
 
• **That ship has sailed** means someth
